lines.trans: The mosaic on this video is thinner than our commission's standards permit.
Recall every copy voluntarily and remake the tape in compliance with our rules.
Realistically speaking, that is completely impossible.
If you refuse to comply, you will be barred from joining this commission.
That suits us to a tee — nobody ever asked to join your club.

words.reading: ネガッタリカナッタリ

lines.trans: Very well, then we will halt retail distribution of all your releases.
Knock yourselves out.
What on earth was that pointless meeting?
Still, it is a hard fact that nearly every distributor has joined them.
Shut out of hiring actresses, and now our sales channels are blockaded too.

できる.gloss: be built; open; be able to

meanings.en: come into existence; be completed; can do
meanings.note: With buildings or stores (店ができる), means a new shop has been built or opened.

examples.text: 駅前に新しいカフェができました。
examples.trans: A new café opened in front of the station.

examples.text: 日本語が少しできます。
examples.trans: I can speak a little Japanese.

meanings.note: Negates verbs or forms じゃない ('is not') in questions like いいんじゃないか.
Marks the subject of existence, emergence, or questions (どれが), and at the end of a polite clause softens a request (のですが).
